name: Parameters.pow_d_ne_neg_one
summary: In ℤ/N₀(P), d(P)² = 1 (as 2(d(P) + 1) = 0 and d(P) is odd) and d(P) ≠ −1; so the powers of d(P) are 1 and d(P), never −1.

steps.claim: d(P) is odd (a prime > 64): d(P) = 2c + 1; and N₀(P) ∣ 2(d(P) + 1), N₀(P) ∤ d(P) + 1 (field d_congr).
In ℤ/N₀(P) these say 2(d(P) + 1) = 0 and d(P) + 1 ≠ 0.
Two-step induction on n: d(P)⁰ = 1 ≠ −1, d(P)¹ = d(P) ≠ −1, and d(P)^{n+2} = d(P)^n·d(P)² = d(P)^n because d(P)² − 1 = (d(P) − 1)(d(P) + 1) = c·2(d(P) + 1) = 0 in ℤ/N₀(P).
